topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the overarching focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Principles of Innate Immune Recognition: PAMPs, DAMPs, and PRRs
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts of how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through conserved molecular patterns and germline-encoded receptors.

topics.label: Pattern Recognition Receptor Families and Inflammasome Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore specific pattern recognition receptor systems, including Toll-like receptors, cytosolic sensors, and the inflammasome pathway, along with their downstream signaling cascades.

topics.label: Inflammatory Execution, Leukocyte Trafficking, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how inflammatory responses are coordinated through sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment into tissues, adaptive immune priming, and severe systemic outcomes.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how the body shuts down acute inflammation, restores damaged tissue, and manages persistent, unresolvable challenges.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the subject of the next session.
